title: IFC-SQRT-TAGS: square-root-width generation tags with exact renumbering

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, let n = ceil(log2 N). The single IFC-SQRT-TAGS algorithm in proof.md, virtual.md and virtual2.md uses the finite exhaustive branch when n < 2^40 and otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=dl=H0=ceil(7r/12)+64ceil(log2 r), cb=floor(sqrt n)-40ceil(log2 n), w=2^ceil(log2 n), RHO=2+8/r, and the remaining uniquely specified capped-pool, tree, source and decoder parameters of virtual2.md Section 8. It uses the counted basis-state bank with EW=4r and exact renumbering in proof.md. From independent ideal coset copies it outputs the complete shift with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8. Its total charged sequential work, including every classical bit operation, memory address, quantum gate, source acquisition and movement, precision/synthesis, uniform circuit generation and preprocessing, is O(n^(163/2) 2^((7/6) sqrt n)). This exact envelope has growth index 1/2. The exponent coefficient is exactly 7/6 and the polynomial power is 163/2. The growing FW circuit, its uniform classical generation and all PREP attempts are charged in the proof. All constants are absolute, independent of N, s and sampled outcomes, and all five claims hold jointly for this one configuration on every execution branch, including failures, discards, aborts, overflow handling, initialization and cleanup.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
